content.text: No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination fee exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding without a redline.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, stipulated sums or early-termination charge on Client, so it meets our preferred position (Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties). Section 14 (p0079) lets Client elect to terminate with services simply running to the last day of the following month and attaches no termination fee or accelerated minimum payment; the non-renewal mechanic in Section 13 (p0078) is likewise fee-free. Compensation in Section 5 (p0045) is ordinary monthly consideration for services actually requested — the "$____ per month" floors are recurring minimum service charges, not a sum payable on termination or on breach, and the disputes clause (p0047) does not convert them into stipulated damages. The spam covenant in Section 7 (p0049) is a bare prohibition with no per-message or fixed-sum penalty against Client. The only monetary cap in the document (p0077) runs in our favour by limiting TrueLink's liability. Nothing to redline; we would resist any later insertion of a termination fee above three months' fees.
